abstract: We have shown that c-myc mRNA levels decrease more than 20-fold when F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells are induced to arrest growth and terminally differentiate to parietal endoderm after exposure to retinoic acid and cyclic AMP (Campisi et al., Cell 36:241-247, 1984). Here, we demonstrate that although growth arrest and full expression of the differentiated phenotype required about 3 days, c-myc mRNA declined abruptly between 8 and 16 h after the addition of retinoic acid and cyclic AMP. The decline was independent of cyclic AMP. We found little or no change in the level of c-myc transcription during differentiation, although two other genes showed marked transcriptional regulation. Thus, decreased c-myc mRNA is a consequence of very early posttranscriptional regulation directed by retinoic acid. Differentiation was not fundamental to this regulation. We have shown that sodium butyrate blocks expression of the differentiated phenotype if added within 8 h of retinoic acid and cyclic AMP (Levine et al., Dev. Biol. 105:443-450, 1984). However, butyrate did not inhibit the decrease in c-myc mRNA. Furthermore, F9 cells partially arrested growth without differentiating when grown in isoleucine-deficient medium. Under these conditions, c-myc mRNA levels also declined. Our results suggest that induction of differentiation-specific genes may be under retinoic acid-mediated control dissimilar from that responsible for the decay of c-myc mRNA. In addition, they raise the possibility that growth arrest may be initiated by reduced c-myc expression.
abstract_ja: F9奇形癌幹細胞は、レチノイン酸とcAMPにより増殖停止と終末分化を起こし、壁側内胚葉となる。この過程でc-myc mRNAは20倍以上低下する。本研究では、レチノイン酸とcAMPの添加後8〜16時間の間にc-myc mRNAが急速に減少することを示した。この減少はcAMPに依存せず、転写の変化は小さいかほとんどなかった。したがって、c-myc mRNAの減少はレチノイン酸による非常に早期の転写後調節の結果である。分化は、この調節に必須ではなかった。ブチレートは分化した表現型の発現を阻害するが、c-myc mRNAの減少は阻害しなかった。さらに、イソロイシン欠乏培地ではF9細胞は分化せずに部分的に増殖停止し、その条件でもc-myc mRNAは減少した。以上の結果は、分化特異的遺伝子の誘導が、c-myc mRNAの減衰とは異なるレチノイン酸による制御を受けている可能性を示唆する。また、c-mycの発現低下が増殖停止の開始に関与する可能性も示された。
